newsitem.title: FINLAND: PK CABLES SEES 1997 EARNINGS UP ON 1996.
newsitem.headline: PK CABLES SEES 1997 EARNINGS UP ON 1996.

text.p: Finnish industrial wiring group PK Cables said on Monday it expected its 1997 full-year profit to be higher than in 1996, when it made a 37.2 million markka profit after financial items.
"Profit for the whole year is (expected) to be better than in the previous year," it said in its first quarter results statement.
Its first quarter profit after financial items was 10.4 million markka compared to 7.1 million in the year-ago period.
First quarter net sales rose to 84.7 million markka from 45.6 million, and the company expected growth in the final part of the year too.

"Net sales are forecast to grow during the final part of the year, owing particularly to the volume increase in truck wiring harnesses, as well as in assembly of telecommunication equipment and cable systems," it said.
